title: μι-verbs — the aorist system; ἵστημι's perfect

paradigms.label: δίδωμι — Aorist Active Indicative
paradigms.notes: The κ-aorist: κ marks only the singular; the plural drops it and shortens the stem (ἔδομεν).

paradigms.label: τίθημι — Aorist Active Indicative
paradigms.notes: κ-aorist again: ἔθηκα in the singular, bare short stem in the plural (ἔθεμεν).

paradigms.label: ἵστημι — Root Aorist (ἔστην)
paradigms.notes: The root aorist: endings straight onto στη- with no marker at all. ἔστην means 'I stood (up)' — intransitive.

paradigms.label: δίδωμι — Aorist Middle Indicative
paradigms.notes: The unreduplicated short stem δο- with the imperfect middle's endings; 2nd singular ἔδου contracts from *ἔδοο.

paradigms.label: τίθημι — Aorist Middle Indicative
paradigms.notes: Unreduplicated θε- + secondary middle endings; ἔθου < *ἔθεο. ἵστημι has no second aorist middle at all.

paradigms.label: ἵστημι — Perfect Active Indicative
paradigms.notes: 'I stand': singular like πεπαίδευκα on ἑστηκ-, but the plural drops the κ and goes athematic on ἑστα- (ἑστᾶσι(ν) contracts).

paradigms.label: ἵστημι — Pluperfect Active Indicative
paradigms.notes: 'I stood': augmented εἱστηκ- in the singular; the plural uses bare unaugmented ἑστα- and prints identically to the perfect (§102 obs.).

paradigms.label: δίδωμι — Aorist Active Subjunctive
paradigms.notes: The present subjunctive minus the reduplication (§102 obs.): δῶμεν vs διδῶμεν.

paradigms.label: δίδωμι — Aorist Active Optative
paradigms.notes: Optative ι on the short stem; the accent never recedes past the ι. H&Q also lists plural alternates in -ίημεν/-ίητε/-ίησαν.

paradigms.label: δίδωμι — Aorist Middle Optative
paradigms.notes: Optative ι on the short stem; the accent never recedes past the ι. H&Q also lists plural alternates in -ίημεν/-ίητε/-ίησαν.

paradigms.label: τίθημι — Aorist Active Subjunctive
paradigms.notes: The present subjunctive minus the reduplication: θῶμεν vs τιθῶμεν.

paradigms.label: τίθημι — Aorist Middle Subjunctive
paradigms.notes: Like the present M/P subjunctive without reduplication.

paradigms.label: τίθημι — Aorist Active Optative
paradigms.notes: Optative ι on the short stem; the accent never recedes past the ι. H&Q also lists plural alternates in -ίημεν/-ίητε/-ίησαν.

paradigms.label: τίθημι — Aorist Middle Optative
paradigms.notes: Optative ι on the short stem; the accent never recedes past the ι. H&Q also lists plural alternates in -ίημεν/-ίητε/-ίησαν. Thematic alternates θοῖτο, θοίμεθα, θοῖσθε, θοῖντο also occur.

paradigms.label: ἵστημι — Aorist Active Subjunctive
paradigms.notes: Stem στε- (as in the present subjunctive); ἔστην has no middle.

paradigms.label: ἵστημι — Aorist Active Optative
paradigms.notes: Optative ι on the short stem; the accent never recedes past the ι. H&Q also lists plural alternates in -ίημεν/-ίητε/-ίησαν.
